web_search._note: For a story someone asks for in Slack, 2b Context searches the web for recent reporting on it. Each source is kept with the words it was quoted for, shown to the editor and listed in the trace.

reddit._note: For every story, 2c Reddit reads how people are reacting in these subreddits. Opinion only: never a source for numbers. Off for now: Reddit's API needs an app Reddit has approved, and Reddit blocks Anthropic's web search. Once Reddit approves an app, set via to api (n8n's Reddit node, credential Reddit connected) and enabled to true.

style.audience: Vancouver residents who follow local news on their phones
style.tone: Plain, calm and specific, like a local radio newsreader
samples: Vancouver logged 218 street flooding reports this week, against a usual 29.3 a week. Mount Pleasant had the most, with 33. The city data does not say why.
